276016447.description:
Cross, Wahl Eversharp, and Unbranded
Vintage Writing Instrument Collection
Lot of 3: Ballpoint, Mechanical Pencil, and Fountain Pen
Approx. 5" Length
Marked Brands
This selection of vintage writing instruments features a classic Cross gold-toned ballpoint pen with an engine-turned chevron pattern. It is paired with a Wahl Eversharp mechanical pencil, noted for its terracotta body and gold-filled hardware. The set is completed by a green lever-filler fountain pen with double gold-toned cap bands, capturing the functional elegance of mid-century stationery design.
Cross pen features the iconic slim profile and signature conical top
Wahl Eversharp pencil is marked "Gold Filled" with a decorative crown
Green fountain pen utilizes a traditional internal lever-fill mechanism
Condition:
Good vintage condition with age-appropriate wear. Surface micro-scratching is present on the green pen. The Wahl pencil shows minor brassing on gold-filled parts. All mechanisms are currently untested for functionality.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.

276231233.description:
Cross
Century 10K Gold Filled Pen and Pencil Set
Vintage, Made in USA
This Cross Century writing set features the sleek, iconic silhouette that has defined the brand's executive aesthetic for decades. Crafted in the USA, these instruments utilize a 10-karat gold-filled process that bonds a thick layer of karat gold to a base metal for enduring luster and durability. The slim profile and engine-turned detailing reflect a mid-century modernist approach to functional luxury, making this set a staple for collectors and professionals alike.
Two-piece set including a ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil
10K Gold Filled construction with signature black conical top accents
Authentic "Cross" branding on clips and "Made in USA" markings on caps
Housed in a vintage green velvet-lined hard shell presentation case
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Both writing instruments show light surface wear and minor micro-scratching consistent with age and occasional use. The mechanical components and twist actions are intact with no visible damage. The presentation case remains structurally sound with light exterior shelf wear and a clean interior. Ink and lead status not confirmed.

276249435.description:
Natural Agate and Citrine Stone Lot - 5 Pieces
Polished Geode Bookends and Crystal Specimen
Vintage Era Decor
This collection features a curated selection of natural mineral specimens, including two distinct pairs of heavy polished geode bookends and a vibrant citrine cluster. These pieces highlight the organic beauty of geological formations, with polished faces contrasting against their natural, rugged exteriors, making them ideal for sophisticated home decor or mineral collections.
Pieces Included:
Pair of banded agate bookends, purple and grey tones with white crystalline centers, polished face - approximately 7.5 inches tall
Pair of quartz geode bookends, creamy white crystalline interior with brown matrix crust, polished face - approximately 8 inches tall
Citrine cluster specimen, golden-amber crystals on matrix, heat-treated variety - approximately 3.5 inches wide
Condition:
All pieces are in excellent decorative condition. Polished faces are smooth with minimal surface wear. As natural specimens, these items feature inherent internal fissures, druzy pockets, and irregular crust textures which are characteristic of the material and not considered defects. Total weight of the lot is 21 pounds.
